## Changes made from the upstream version

Modified by SkillOffice on 2026-11-06:

- Rewrote the skill in SkillOffice format; body reduced from about 490 lines to about 80.
- Kept the seven sweeps, the point-edit mode and the AI-pattern check; moved sweep detail, quick checks, the optional expert panel and refresh notes into `references/sweeps.md`.
- Output now uses the SkillOffice findings format so the department manager can merge duplicates.
- The expert panel is optional and its scores are presented as opinions; the upstream "iterate until all personas score 7+" loop was removed to respect the single correction cycle rule.
- Removed references to the upstream product-marketing context file and upstream skills not imported.
- Added safety, context fields and handoff sections.

## Files not imported

- `references/plain-english-alternatives.md`, `references/checklist.md`, `references/content-refresh.md`: key points condensed into `references/sweeps.md`.
- `evals/evals.json`: replaced with SkillOffice evals.
